privacyDraft: Draft privacy notice — pending legal review
privacyBody: SnapMatch is being developed to help guests find their photos within a single event. Before camera access, guests will be asked for consent. Selfies will be processed in memory for matching and will not be saved. Event face data will expire on the date shown for that event. Photos will be private, and guests will receive access only to their matched photos. A removal option will be provided. Contact details, retention rules, legal basis and processor information must be completed before launch.

faqs.q: Will SnapMatch fit the way I work?
faqs.a: If your calendar is full of events and your cards are full of photographs, SnapMatch gives the work around each shoot a home: uploads, processing, delivery settings and sharing tools.

faqs.q: Is it just for one kind of event?
faqs.a: Bring the whole calendar: conferences, concerts, weddings, birthdays, corporate events and more. Each shoot gets its own collection and settings.

faqs.q: What if an upload is interrupted?
faqs.a: Select the same files when you return. SnapMatch recognises completed uploads and restarts interrupted files without adding duplicates. Progress is shown for each file.

faqs.q: Who chooses the download and watermark settings?
faqs.a: You do, for each event. Decide whether original downloads are allowed, and choose the watermark setting before uploading so the processed collection stays consistent.

faqs.q: Can I take the event link into the venue?
faqs.a: Yes. Download a QR code as a PNG or an A5 poster with the event details. Keep them with the event link for your client handover.
